messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Compare a full EVM smart-contract wallet operated by each sovereign enterprise against the following source-frozen requirements and technical facts. Authoritative legal facts: Article 50 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 applies from 2 August 2026. Providers of interactive AI systems must inform natural persons they are interacting with AI unless obvious. Providers of systems generating synthetic audio/image/video/text must machine-readably mark outputs and make them detectable, using solutions effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as technically feasible. Deployers must disclose emotion recognition/biometric categorisation, deepfakes, and AI-generated/manipulated public-interest text in the specified cases. Information must be clear, distinguishable, accessible and available by first interaction/exposure. The final June 2026 voluntary Code's provider section expects for most disseminable content two marking layers: digitally signed/time-stamped metadata and imperceptible watermarking; free-form text has special handling. It treats fingerprinting/logging as optional supplemental mechanisms, requires detection access, testing, monitoring, documentation, and accessibility, and permits third-party marking/detection providers without shifting ultimate provider responsibility. It requires watermark detection interoperability by 2 February 2027. Authoritative technical facts: an EVM smart-contract wallet can expose a stable address, validate arbitrary authorization logic and contract signatures, rotate/delegate signers according to its code, hold/pay tokens, and make on-chain transactions. A raw EVM address does not by itself bind to a legal person, embed metadata or watermarks into content, survive copy/paste or analogue transformations, create visible/accessibility disclosures, classify provider/deployer roles, or prove an asserted event happened. C2PA currently roots manifest trust in X.509 signing credentials and content binding rather than raw EVM addresses. Local settlement law makes each enterprise sovereign, requires explicit boundary contracts, treats x402 only as settlement of a real priced boundary, uses ActivityStreams/ActivityPub at enterprise borders and EAVT/Datom as monotone source log. Produce: contributions a wallet can make; requirements it cannot satisfy; architecture roles that must stay separate; and the strongest defensible formulation of the hypothesis. Do not recommend implementation or claim legal advice.
